name: [New Custom & Codes!] Infinity Sea 2
desc:
Welcome to Infinity Sea 2! Become a greater swordsman or a powerful fruit user! You can choose your fighting style and fight against strong enemies.

Current Level Cap: 415. 

Current game fruits: Smoke, Bomb, Sand, Venom, Light, Soap, Suke, Spin, Spike, Magma, Bara

Basic controls:
M - Menu
Shift - Sprint
M1 - Click
Q - Dash
G - Use Mount

Skills:
Z - X - C - V - F

FAQ:
- Fruits spawn around the map every hour and despawn every 30 minutes
- You DONT need to spin fruit you can buy it at Makino's Shop
